request.project_task: Create a parcel tracking and delivery confirmation service.
request.project_goal: Give senders and recipients a reliable parcel status.
request.project_description: Carrier events update parcel status; the recipient confirms delivery or reports a problem.

functional_requirements.text: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.

atoms.text: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.

functional_requirements.text: A carrier posts parcel scan events.

atoms.text: A carrier posts parcel scan events.

functional_requirements.text: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.

atoms.text: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.

functional_requirements.text: A recipient views the current status.

atoms.text: A recipient views the current status.

functional_requirements.text: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.

atoms.text: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.

non_functional_requirements.text: Duplicate carrier events must be idempotent.
Tracking history must be retained for one year.

actors.name: Sender
actors.description: Person or organization that creates a shipment with recipient details.

actors.name: Carrier
actors.description: Logistics provider that posts parcel scan events.

actors.name: Recipient
actors.description: Person who receives the parcel and views status or confirms delivery/reports damage.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Parcel Track service that derives status and retains history.

use_cases.name: Create Shipment
use_cases.goal: Allow a sender to register a new shipment with recipient details so it can be tracked.
use_cases.trigger: Sender initiates creation of a new shipment.

preconditions.text: Sender is authenticated and authorized to create shipments.

success_postconditions.text: A new shipment record exists with recipient details and a unique tracking identifier.

failure_postconditions.text: No shipment record is created; sender is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Sender initiates creation of a new shipment.
steps.expected_result: System presents the shipment creation form.

steps.action: Sender enters recipient details and submits the form.
System creates the shipment record with a unique tracking identifier.
steps.expected_result: Shipment is created and sender receives confirmation with tracking identifier.

steps.action: Sender submits shipment form with missing or invalid recipient details.
steps.expected_result: System rejects the submission and displays validation errors.

steps.action: Sender corrects the details and resubmits.

user_stories.capability: create a shipment with recipient details
user_stories.benefit: I can initiate tracking for a parcel I am sending.

system_stories.system_action: Validate recipient details and persist a new shipment record with a unique tracking identifier.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure shipment data is complete and uniquely identifiable for tracking.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Create Shipment
Goal: Allow a sender to register a new shipment with recipient details so it can be tracked.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Sender initiates creation of a new shipment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Sender is authenticated and authorized to create shipments.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Sender initiates creation of a new shipment.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Sender enters recipient details and submits the form.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System creates the shipment record with a unique tracking identifier.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Invalid recipient details
Source FRs: FR-001

use_cases.name: Post Parcel Scan Event
use_cases.goal: Allow a carrier to post parcel scan events so the system can update tracking status.
use_cases.trigger: Carrier scans a parcel at a checkpoint and posts the event.

preconditions.text: Carrier is authenticated and authorized to post events.
The parcel has an existing shipment record.

success_postconditions.text: The scan event is accepted and stored; duplicate events are handled idempotently.

failure_postconditions.text: The event is rejected; carrier is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Carrier scans a parcel and submits a scan event with tracking identifier, timestamp, and location.
System validates the event and checks for duplicates.
steps.expected_result: Event is accepted if valid and not a duplicate.

steps.action: System stores the accepted event and updates the parcel status.
steps.expected_result: Event is recorded and current status is derived.

steps.action: Carrier submits a scan event that was already posted.
steps.expected_result: System detects duplicate and ignores it without error.

steps.action: Carrier submits a scan event with an unknown tracking identifier.
steps.expected_result: System rejects the event and returns an error.

user_stories.benefit: I can update the parcel's tracking status as it moves.

system_stories.system_action: Validate, deduplicate, and store carrier scan events; derive current parcel status.
system_stories.responsibility: Maintain accurate and idempotent event processing for tracking.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Post Parcel Scan Event
Goal: Allow a carrier to post parcel scan events so the system can update tracking status.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Carrier scans a parcel at a checkpoint and posts the event.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Carrier is authenticated and authorized to post events.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The parcel has an existing shipment record.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Carrier scans a parcel and submits a scan event with tracking identifier, timestamp, and location.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System validates the event and checks for duplicates.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] System stores the accepted event and updates the parcel status.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-ALT-001: Duplicate scan event
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Unknown tracking identifier
Source FRs: FR-002, FR-003

use_cases.name: View Parcel Status
use_cases.goal: Allow a recipient to view the current status of their parcel.
use_cases.trigger: Recipient requests the current status of a parcel.

preconditions.text: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to view the parcel.
The parcel has an existing shipment record.

success_postconditions.text: Recipient is shown the current parcel status derived from accepted events.

failure_postconditions.text: Recipient is informed that status cannot be retrieved.

steps.action: Recipient requests the current status of a parcel using its tracking identifier.
System derives the current status from accepted events.
System displays the current status to the recipient.
steps.expected_result: Recipient sees the current parcel status.

steps.action: Recipient requests status for an unknown tracking identifier.

user_stories.capability: view the current status of my parcel
user_stories.benefit: I know where my parcel is and when to expect it.

system_stories.system_action: Derive and present the current parcel status from accepted events.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide accurate and timely status information to recipients.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — View Parcel Status
Goal: Allow a recipient to view the current status of their parcel.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Recipient requests the current status of a parcel.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to view the parcel.
  - PRE-UC003-002: The parcel has an existing shipment record.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Recipient requests the current status of a parcel using its tracking identifier.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] System derives the current status from accepted events.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] System displays the current status to the recipient.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Parcel not found
Source FRs: FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Confirm Delivery or Report Damage
use_cases.goal: Allow a recipient to confirm successful delivery or report damage to the parcel.
use_cases.trigger: Recipient receives the parcel and confirms delivery or reports damage.

preconditions.text: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to act on the parcel.
The parcel has an existing shipment record and is marked as delivered or out for delivery.

success_postconditions.text: Delivery confirmation or damage report is recorded and status is updated.

failure_postconditions.text: The confirmation or report is not recorded; recipient is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Recipient indicates that the parcel was delivered successfully.
System updates the parcel status to delivered.
Recipient reports that the parcel arrived damaged.
System updates the parcel status to reflect a problem.
Recipient attempts to confirm delivery for a parcel that is not yet out for delivery.
steps.expected_result: System rejects the action and informs the recipient.

user_stories.benefit: I can close the delivery loop or raise an issue promptly.

system_stories.system_action: Record delivery confirmation or damage report and update parcel status accordingly.
system_stories.responsibility: Capture recipient feedback and reflect it in tracking status.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Confirm Delivery or Report Damage
Goal: Allow a recipient to confirm successful delivery or report damage to the parcel.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Recipient receives the parcel and confirms delivery or reports damage.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to act on the parcel.
  - PRE-UC004-002: The parcel has an existing shipment record and is marked as delivered or out for delivery.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Recipient indicates that the parcel was delivered successfully.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] System updates the parcel status to delivered.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC004-ALT-001: Recipient reports damage
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC004-EXC-001: Parcel not eligible for confirmation
Source FRs: FR-005, FR-003
